captions.detailed: A pair of marine 7x50 porro-prism binoculars with a dark, rubberized housing. The assembly consists of two distinct optical barrels connected by a central hinge mechanism, which allows for adjustable interpupillary distance. The lenses feature a distinct teal-blue coating on both the large objective ends and the smaller eyepieces, while a central focus wheel is positioned along the hinge axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a marine 7x50 porro-prism binocular with a dark rubberized finish, featuring two adjustable barrels connected by a central revolute hinge, complete with a central focus knob and teal-tinted optical lenses.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining three main parts: a central hinge/bridge assembly and two optical barrels (left and right). The central hinge is built using cylinders for the main hinge pins and focus knob. Each barrel is modeled by combining multiple coaxial cylinders of varying diameters to form the objective lens housing, the main body, and the eyepiece, which are then offset laterally and connected to the central hinge using revolute joints to allow realistic folding movement. Lenses are represented as thin cylinders with a distinct teal material color.
